resources.string: The Firefox engine, Rocks bottom-bar gestures, and browser extensions.
Drag the floating address bar sideways to switch tabs. Scroll down to shrink it; scroll up or tap the pill to expand. Short drags snap back.

Tabs, bookmarks, history, downloads, uploads and extensions are available. Restart restores tab URLs, not forms, scroll positions or navigation stacks. Default browser integration, find in page, desktop mode and website device permissions are included. Password management and private browsing are not included.
Install extensions and open their panels on websites. Enable, disable, uninstall and check for updates; new permissions require confirmation.
A Rocks reading extension. Change page background and text spacing without a network download.
Apply dark reading styles to websites. Use its panel to enable or disable dark mode for each site.
Filter ads and some tracking requests. Its panel shows filtering activity for the current website.
Bundled with the app · Rocks demo extension
Mozilla add-ons · Internet required to install
Open a website before using an extension panel. Changing extension state reloads loaded pages. Try Rocks Paper if Mozilla is unreachable.
